note:
A fresh check found these problems in this version. Fix each one, and keep everything that is right:
- Card, fact: An enterprise agreement is made for one employer (enterprise), and it often covers many workplaces, such as a chain of stores. 'For one workplace' is a simplification that could mislead. 'For one business or employer' would be more accurate. The same simplification appears in the chapter outline and the remember line.

rejected.title: Awards, agreements and contracts
card: Award
sets the minimum pay and conditions for workers in an industry or occupation, such as retail or hospitality. It applies to the employers and workers in that industry that it covers.
Enterprise agreement
is negotiated between an employer and its employees (often through a union) for one workplace. It must leave each worker better off overall than the award would.
Common law contract
is an agreement between an employer and one worker. It sets out their terms, such as the job, the pay and the hours, and it can include more than an award or agreement requires.
A contract cannot give a worker less than the minimum set by an award or agreement that covers them.
rejected.remember: Award: one industry. Agreement: one workplace. Contract: one worker.

a.q: Sam owns a single bakery in Orange. He and his staff negotiate pay and hours that apply only to that bakery. What is this arrangement called?
opts: An enterprise agreement
An award
A common law contract
A grievance procedure
a.why: Terms negotiated between an employer and its staff for one workplace are an enterprise agreement. An award covers a whole industry, and a common law contract is made with one worker, not the whole staff.
a.clue: Think about who negotiated it and how many workplaces it covers.

b.q: Priya starts as a waiter in a Newcastle café. The industry award sets a minimum hourly rate. Her signed contract offers less than that rate. What is the result?
opts: Priya must be paid at least the award rate
Priya gets the lower rate because she signed
Priya gets the award rate only if she joins a union
Priya gets the lower rate if the café is small
b.why: A contract cannot give a worker less than the minimum in an award that covers them, so Priya must get at least the award rate. Signing the contract does not remove that minimum.
b.clue: Which of the three sets the minimum that others cannot go below?
